title: Symmetry/full-q comparison mismatch
symptom: The symmetry-enabled GW branch does not agree with the full-q branch within the registered symmetry_fullq_tolerance_ev (e.g. 0.0001 eV).
root_cause: A stale or mismatched stru_out, a truncated state space (nbands < nbasis), an indefinite Coulomb matrix, or a k-grid/basis discrepancy between the two branches. In LibRPA 0.7.0 the rotation reconstruction is rebuilt from the symmetry metadata in stru_out; a missing or wrong stru_out breaks it.
minimal_fix: Keep nbands, k-meshes, shrink settings, thresholds, PP/NAO/ABFS files, and helper scripts identical between the two branches; patch only the symmetry-related keys and the stru_out-producing SCF stage. Verify stru_out comes from the same symmetry-enabled SCF and is present in the LibRPA working directory.
validation: Gate KS, EXX, GW, and the fundamental gap independently at the registered symmetry tolerance; a stable gap alone cannot accept the pair. A matching symmetry/full-q control (e.g. the BN 4x4x4 no-head/wing 8-q to 64-q control) should agree to 1e-5 eV.
avoid: Relaxing the symmetry gate, or reusing a full-q stru_out for a symmetry run (or vice versa) based on matching lattice constants and basis dimensions alone.
source: abacus-librpa-strict2d-ewald-headwing; oh-my-librpa gw-route periodic symmetry lane; ~/.codex sessions on symmetry bug.
